title: Deep Kinetic JKO schemes for Vlasov-Fokker-Planck Equations
summary: We introduce a deep neural network-based numerical method for solving kinetic Fokker Planck equations, including both linear and nonlinear cases. Building upon the conservative dissipative structure of Vlasov-type equations, we formulate a class of generalized minimizing movement schemes as iterative constrained minimization problems: the conservative part determines the constraint set, while the dissipative part defines the objective functional.
